HE READS. IT FEEDS.

Based on the novel by Josh Alletto, Jason Culver, James Ower

Written by Erik Widmark and Casey Locke

Directed by Thomas Freccione and Derek Porter

Starring: Dan Verson, Maggie Ritchie, Sabrina Arellano

Written by C.J. Arelland, C.J. Arellano & Josh Alletto
description: A young man stands in a library aisle holding a book, with a red, abstract symbol on his chest. The poster is titled 'PARASITIC' with a tagline 'HE READS. IT FEEDS.'
